VERIFY-COMMAND DEFECT TAXONOMY item (6): prose-vs-structured assertion — the command asserts key presence, not field values; and item (1): weak anchor that would match even a malformed entry.
findings.finding: AC2's proving command (`grep '"T15"' src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json`) only confirms the key string is present; it does NOT verify the required field values (exec: AGENT, facet: overlay-derisk, overlay_routing: llm, applies_at.suppress_types: ["bug"]) that the AC text claims to prove. jq -e '.T15 | select(.exec=="AGENT" and .facet=="overlay-derisk" and .overlay_routing=="llm" and (.applies_at.suppress_types | index("bug") != null))' src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json
